Make your next connection count

There’s a place for you in Texas Wagyu.

TWA offers membership paths for producers and supporters of the Wagyu breed. Choose the fit that reflects how you want to take part.

Associate

$150 / year

For supporters of Wagyu who do not own Wagyu cattle. Includes member newsletter and access to in-person events.

Join TWA

Preferred

$150 / year

For Wagyu cattle producers, with voting privileges, member-only resources, classifieds, and newsletter access.

Join TWA

Preferred Plus

$433 / year

Preferred membership with an additional Australian Wagyu Association membership.

Join TWA

Lifetime

$1,500 one time

Lifetime membership for Wagyu cattle producers, with special member recognition.

Join TWA
